stretch_features: Add automated regression tests for the most important edge cases.
Document configuration and supported Python versions.
Add a short architecture note explaining the boundary between user input, application logic, and persistence or external services.

tests.name: Functional behavior
criteria: All required features work on representative inputs.
Expected results and failure behavior are documented.

tests.name: Reliability and security
criteria: Invalid input and expected external failures are handled.
No real credentials or personal data are committed.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: A second developer can follow the setup instructions.
The supported Python version and dependency installation steps are stated.

review_method: Human-reviewed project rubric; automated checks support review but do not prove application quality or security.
